{%- comment -%}
/llms.txt (#191): an index of the site for language models and the assistants that read it,
in the format proposed at llmstxt.org (a proposal, not a standard: cheap and harmless).
An H1, a one-paragraph summary in a blockquote, then sections of links, one line each.

Generated at every build from site data (front matter descriptions, the latest posts), so it
never goes stale: a new main page goes in the `pages` list below. Titles go through
`strip_emoji_shortcodes`, because jemoji only renders HTML and a .txt would keep ":computer:".
Videos are the posts synced from the YouTube channel (their slug starts with youtube-); the
Blog section is the other blog posts, notes with an embedded video included. Post links point at their Markdown twins (#192, _plugins/markdown_twins.rb), the plain
text an assistant wants. Never cached by sw.js (NEVER_CACHE), like sitemap.xml.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign me = site.social.name | default: site.title -%}
{%- assign projects = site.posts | where: "category", "project" | where_exp: "p", "p.github" -%}
{%- assign blog = site.posts | where: "category", "blog" -%}
{%- assign videos = blog | where_exp: "p", "p.url contains '/youtube-'" -%}
# {{ me }}

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines }}

{{ me }} is a software and DevOps engineer based in Milan, Italy. This site ({{ site.url }}) holds his open-source projects, notes on DevOps, live video streaming, Go and infrastructure, and videos from his YouTube channel. Posts are in English or Italian. Profiles: {% for l in site.social.links %}{{ l }}{% unless forloop.last %}, {% endunless %}{% endfor %}.

## About
{% assign pages = "/about/,/stack/,/gear/" | split: "," -%}
{%- for url in pages -%}
{%- assign pg = site.pages | where: "url", url | first -%}
{%- if pg %}
- [{{ pg.title }}]({{ site.url }}{{ pg.url }}): {{ pg.description | strip_newlines }}
{%- endif -%}
{%- endfor %}

## Projects

{% assign pg = site.pages | where: "url", "/projects/" | first -%}
- [All projects]({{ site.url }}/projects/): {{ pg.description | strip_newlines }}
{%- for p in projects limit: 12 %}
- [{{ p.title | strip_emoji_shortcodes | strip }}]({{ site.url }}{{ p.url | replace: '.html', '.md' }}): {{ p.description | strip_newlines }}
{%- endfor %}

## Blog

{% assign pg = site.pages | where: "url", "/blog/" | first -%}
- [Blog]({{ site.url }}/blog/): {{ pg.description | strip_newlines }}
{%- assign shown = 0 -%}
{%- for p in blog -%}
{%- if shown >= 12 %}{% break %}{% endif -%}
{%- unless p.url contains '/youtube-' %}
- [{{ p.title | strip_emoji_shortcodes | strip }}]({{ site.url }}{{ p.url | replace: '.html', '.md' }}): {{ p.description | strip_newlines }}
{%- assign shown = shown | plus: 1 -%}
{%- endunless -%}
{%- endfor %}

## Videos

{% assign pg = site.pages | where: "url", "/videos/" | first -%}
- [All videos]({{ site.url }}/videos/): {{ pg.description | strip_newlines }}
{%- for p in videos limit: 6 %}
- [{{ p.title | strip_emoji_shortcodes | strip }}]({{ site.url }}{{ p.url | replace: '.html', '.md' }}): {{ p.description | strip_newlines }}
{%- endfor %}
